body.p: The Office Action dated October 24, 2024 ("Office Action"), has been carefully reviewed and these remarks are responsive thereto. Claims 1-8 and 10-20 have been amended. No new matter has been added. Claims 1-20 remain pending in this application. Reconsideration and allowance of the present application are respectfully requested.

Applicant thanks Examiner Hoel for the courtesies extended to Applicant's undersigned representative during the telephonic interview of January 10, 2025. The following remarks include Applicant's statement of the substance of the interview in accordance with MPEP § 713.04. During the interview, Examiner Hoel and Applicant's representative discussed the pending rejections and the amended claims. Examiner Hoel agreed that the amendments as filed herein overcome all pending rejections. Examiner Hoel noted that an updated prior art search would be performed in view of the amendments.

Claims 1-20 are rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 101 because the claimed invention is allegedly directed to an abstract idea without significantly more. As noted above, during the Examiner Interview of January 10, 2025, Examiner Hoel agreed that the amendments as filed herein, without concession to the merits of the pending rejections, overcome the rejections under 35 U.S.C. § 101. Withdrawal of the rejection is requested.

Claims 1-20 stand rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 112, first paragraph, as allegedly failing to comply with the written description requirement. Claims 1-20 stand rejected under 35 U.S.C. 112(b) or 35 U.S.C. 112 (pre-AIA), second paragraph, as being indefinite for failing to particularly point out and distinctly claim the subject matter which the inventor or a joint inventor, or for pre- AIA the applicant regards as the invention. As noted above, during the Examiner Interview of January 10, 2025, Examiner Hoel agreed that the amendments as filed herein, without concession to
the merits of the pending rejections, overcome the rejections under 35 U.S.C. § 112. Withdrawal of the rejection is requested.

Claims 1-20 stand rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 103(a) as allegedly being unpatentable over Chinese Patent Publication No. 110613938 (hereinafter "Liu") in view of U.S. Patent Application Publication No. 2007/0243914 (hereinafter "Yan"). As noted above, during the Examiner Interview of January 10, 2025, Examiner Hoel agreed that the amendments as filed herein, without concession to the merits of the pending rejections, overcome the rejections under 35 U.S.C. § 103, at least because the prior art does not disclose "determining whether the first virtual prop may be placed at a region in contact with a placement point; controlling, based on a triggering option for the first virtual prop and a determination that the first virtual prop may be placed at the region, the first virtual character to launch the first virtual prop to the placement point using a predetermined flight path, wherein the first virtual prop is configured to intercept, within a defense range of the region, a target virtual prop configured to chase a target virtual character," among other claimed features. Withdrawal of the rejection is requested.

Based on the foregoing, Applicant respectfully submits that the application is in condition for allowance and a Notice to that effect is earnestly solicited. Should the Examiner believe that anything further is desirable in order to place the application in even better form for allowance, the Examiner is invited to contact Applicant's undersigned representative at the below-listed number.
